propositions: A new isolated GitHub Actions adapter must parse coverage percentage from run-log tail via word-boundary grep on the pytest-cov TOTAL line and extract CI-health metadata (status, conclusion, duration) from run JSON.

The harvester script must pull recent test.yml run logs and metadata via the GHA API, process them through the adapter, and persist labeled snapshots to the tracked .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson file.
The harvester must compute red-to-green recovery intervals from consecutive fail-then-pass run pairs and measure flake/recheck rate across repeated runs on a single commit.
The core metrics modules (registry.py, __init__.py, and future _commands/metrics.py) must not import the GitHub Actions adapter to maintain portability and isolation.

Unit tests must validate coverage extraction against fixture logs yielding exactly 84.2%, red-green recovery interval computation from fixture runs, and correct snapshot persistence to the tracked store path (not reports/).
